name: Abu Qays ibn al-Aslat
bio: Abu Qays was a poet and spokesman of the Aws in Yathrib, later called Medina. He commanded men of the Aws in their fighting with the Khazraj before the Hijra. Al-Aslat was his father Amir’s byname, and Sayfi is the personal name al-Zirikli gives the poet. Traditions describe his search for the religion of Abraham. Al-Zirikli dates his death in Medina to 1 AH (622 CE).
